subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the Control UI get a dedicated channel-based separated/merged session view, or should this be folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: The code already exposes channel metadata, but the requested merged timeline and separated tabs require product choices about privacy, routing, aggregation, and overlap with the broader sessions workspace before implementation is safe.

options.title: Keep Dedicated Channel View
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical Control UI channel-view design and scope an implementation around separated channel tabs plus an explicitly defined merged timeline.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Make the broader sessions workspace issue own channel grouping, peek, status, and reply semantics, then close this issue only after that design explicitly covers separated and merged channel views.

options.title: Defer Merged Timeline
options.body: Implement only a lower-risk channel filter/separated view first and leave cross-channel timeline aggregation for a later product decision.

recommendation.title: Keep Dedicated Channel View
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical Control UI channel-view design and scope an implementation around separated channel tabs plus an explicitly defined merged timeline.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership plus recent UI/session history makes @steipete the best available routing owner for the product/API direction choice.
